xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3229: Planning promotion has no recovery owner: a finalized-but-unpromoted plan stalls forever if the dashboard is down at finalize time (PAN-3212 sat 9.5h)

plan.title: Pending-promotion marker + deacon recovery owner for finalized-but-unpromoted plans
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: pan plan finalize retries promotion (POST /api/issues/:id/complete-planning) for only 15s (plan-finalize.ts:366-375). A deploy-window outage outlasts that budget, and no server-side owner scans for the resulting finalized-but-unpromoted state: orphan-proposed-reconciler's entry condition is a spec ALREADY promoted by the very endpoint that failed. PAN-3212 stalled 9.5h until a human ran pan plan done.
narratives.Proposal: Keep the 15s CLI budget but make recovery server-owned: (1) finalize writes a durable marker <workspace>/.overdeck/pending-promotion.json when retries are exhausted and prints honest 'deferred to deacon' wording; (2) a new deacon patrol reconciler scans all projects' workspaces for markers (plus defensively for markerless proposed workspace specs with no promoted counterpart via findSpecByIssue), re-drives promotion through the normal endpoint with the internal token, clears markers on convergence, and trips needs-you after 5 bounded failures; (3) completePlanningForIssue deletes the marker on every successful promotion path. Full brief: .pan/drafts/PAN-3229.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT fix orphan-proposed-reconciler's legacy .pan/specs path blindness for migrated projects (separately filed issue)
- Do NOT change the 90s AbortError no-retry behavior in promotePlanning (PAN-2243 rationale stands)
- Do NOT extend the CLI's 15s retry budget or change the finalize exit-code contract
- Do NOT add a boot-reconciliation hook or any second trigger path beyond the 60s patrol
- Do NOT write markers from pan plan done (finalize is the single marker author)
- Do NOT add dashboard UI surfaces beyond the existing activity feed and needs-you mechanism
- Do NOT modify planning-agent prompts or ad-hoc health-watcher behavior

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the 15s promotePlanning retry budget; marker + patrol is the recovery owner (issue offered either/or).
autoDecisions.rationale: Deploy outages last minutes; any inline budget loses. The deacon only runs while the dashboard is up, so patrol recovery inherently waits out the outage and converges on the first cycle after recovery.

autoDecisions.summary: Finalize exit code stays 1 on promotion failure; honesty via wording + promotionDeferred:true in --json.
autoDecisions.rationale: Exit 0 would silently change the contract for emitAutoPromotePhase consumers and orchestrators. The PAN-3212 harm was silence, not the exit code.

autoDecisions.summary: Reconciler omits autoSpawn from the POST body; the persisted auto-spawn-on-finalize stamp decides.
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveAutoSpawnOnFinalize (planning-promotion.ts:482) already honors the launch-time intent, and explicit autoSpawn:true triggers the origin gate (planning-promotion.ts:493-496) that an internal caller need not enter.

autoDecisions.summary: Grace windows: 120s marker age before acting, 5min spec mtime for markerless defensive candidates; needs-you after 5 failed patrol attempts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids racing the CLI's own 15s retry and freshly-running finalize sessions while keeping worst-case added latency well under one operator-noticeable interval; 5 attempts ≈ 5 minutes of healthy-dashboard failures is genuine dead-end territory.

autoDecisions.summary: Promoted-counterpart checks use findSpecByIssue (state-worktree aware), not a raw .pan/specs readdir.
autoDecisions.rationale: Migrated projects keep specs on overdeck-state; copying the orphan-proposed-reconciler's legacy scan would reproduce the separately-filed blindness in new code.
Both the CLI writer and server/deacon consumers need it; pan-dir/types.ts already exports PAN_SPEC_FILENAME and avoids server code importing a CLI module.

items.title: Write durable pending-promotion marker and deferred wording in pan plan finalize

narrative.Action: Add PENDING_PROMOTION_FILENAME = 'pending-promotion.json' to src/lib/pan-dir/types.ts. In plan-finalize.ts add PendingPromotionMarker type ({version:'1', issueId, canonicalFilename, noPrd, autoSpawnRequested, finalizedAt, lastError, lastAttemptAt, patrolAttempts}) and exported writePendingPromotionMarker(workspacePath, marker) using temp+rename like stampPlanForFinalization. In the !noPromote && !promoted branch (currently lines 343-352), write the marker to <workspacePath>/.overdeck/pending-promotion.json, replace the failure copy with 'Promotion deferred — the dashboard was unreachable. A pending-promotion marker was written; the deacon will complete promotion automatically once the dashboard is healthy. Manual fallback: pan plan done <id>.', and add promotionDeferred:true|false to the --json payload. Exit code stays 1. Add .overdeck/pending-promotion.json to .gitignore next to .overdeck/continue.json (~line 221). Tests use vi.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTimeAsync for the 1s/2s/4s/8s backoff. Full schema and before/after copy: .pan/drafts/PAN-3229.md WI-1.

items.title: Given all 5 promotion attempts fail with connection errors under fake timers, finalize creates .overdeck/pending-promotion.json containing issueId, canonicalFilename, noPrd, finalizedAt, lastError, and patrolAttempts: 0
On deferred promotion, human output contains 'deferred' and names the deacon as the recovery owner, and --json output emits promotionDeferred: true while still exiting 1
Given --no-promote or a successful promotion, finalize creates no pending-promotion.json file
Given a workspace containing a freshly written marker, git status --porcelain produces no output for .overdeck/pending-promotion.json because .gitignore contains the new entry
Add pending-promotion deacon reconciler module with bounded needs-you escalation

expected_outputs: pending-promotion-reconciler.test.ts passes with all scenario cases

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/pending-promotion-reconciler.ts modeled on orphan-proposed-reconciler.ts (injectable options object: fetch, projects, clock, dashboardOrigin; logReconcilerDiagnostic-style console diagnostics; activity emission only for actioned outcomes). findPendingPromotionCandidates: per project from listProjects, enumerate <projectPath>/workspaces/feature-* dirs (skip -strike suffix), candidate = readable .overdeck/pending-promotion.json marker OR defensively a workspace spec with plan.status==='proposed', parseable issue id, no promoted counterpart via Effect.runPromise(findSpecByIssue(projectPath, issueId)), spec mtime > 5min. reconcilePendingPromotions: skip closed issues (isIssueClosed); if findSpecByIssue finds the promoted spec, delete marker without POSTing; skip candidates younger than 120s; else POST /api/issues/:id/complete-planning at internalDashboardOrigin() with INTERNAL_TOKEN_HEADER and body {noPrd from marker, startedBy:'pending-promotion-reconciler'}. HTTP 200 success without skipped → delete marker + activity entry; 202/inFlight/skipped body → leave marker untouched; failure → rewrite marker with patrolAttempts+1/lastError/lastAttemptAt (creating the marker for markerless candidates), and at patrolAttempts>=5 call recordDeadEndNeedsYou(issueId, 'pending-promotion', finalizedAt, self-contained operator message naming pan plan done <id> as fallback), continuing to retry each cycle. No execSync anywhere. Full behavior table: .pan/drafts/PAN-3229.md WI-2.

items.title: Given a marker with noPrd:true and a healthy endpoint mock, the reconciler POSTs complete-planning with body noPrd:true and deletes the marker on HTTP 200
Given the promoted counterpart already exists via findSpecByIssue, the reconciler deletes the marker and issues no POST; given HTTP 202 or a skipped body, it preserves the marker unchanged
Given a marker younger than 120 seconds or a closed issue or a feature-*-strike directory, the reconciler skips it and returns no action for it
Given repeated endpoint failures, the reconciler persists incremented patrolAttempts into the marker and on the 5th failure calls recordDeadEndNeedsYou with recoveryPath 'pending-promotion'
Given a markerless workspace spec with plan.status 'proposed', mtime older than 5 minutes, and no promoted counterpart, the reconciler detects it as a candidate and drives the same POST path

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/__tests__/pending-promotion-convergence.test.ts covering the PAN-3229 incident end-to-end at unit level: (1) drive the exported CLI failure path (promotePlanning with a fetch mock refusing connections, vi.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTimeAsync through the 1s/2s/4s/8s backoff) or call writePendingPromotionMarker exactly as that path does, producing a marker in a temp workspace; (2) run reconcilePendingPromotions with an injected fetch returning HTTP 200 success and a clock past the 120s grace. Assert exactly one POST to /api/issues/<id>/complete-planning, the marker file no longer exists, and one action string is returned; (3) a second reconciler pass returns zero actions (idempotent).

items.title: The test produces the marker via the same code path the CLI failure branch uses under fake timers, never via hand-rolled JSON
One reconciler pass against a healthy endpoint mock produces exactly one complete-planning POST and deletes the marker file, so a subsequent existsSync on the marker path returns false
A second reconciler pass after convergence returns an empty action list, proving idempotence
